go_live.verdict_reason: All hard + soft gates pass, including Bayesian subgroup coverage. Safe to open online traffic with the existing fairness floor.

lift_vs_keep.rule: Bandit business reward ≥ Keep, or within 2% when Keep share ≥75%

lift_nonnegative.rule: Strict lift ≥ 0 required for READY (else CONDITIONAL if hard gates pass)

fairness_floor.rule: Protected Keep rate ≥ 80% of global Keep

granularity_support.rule: Context leaves grown under min_support + MI

human_share_sane.rule: Keep ≥ 20%, human ≤ 70%; human≥1% unless nearly-full automation

learning_stability.rule: Late-batch reward not collapsing vs early (sign-safe)

oracle_gap_bounded.rule: Regret vs oracle < 70% of |oracle|, or clear lift vs Keep

bayesian_subgroup_confidence.rule: ≥2 mature leaves and ≥55% traffic mass in leaves where the Normal-mean posterior confidently prefers Keep or a challenger (P≥0.55 Keep-stable / P≥0.60 beats Keep)

evaluator_rubric.READY: All gates pass (hard + soft). Bayesian subgroup mass ≥55% confident.
evaluator_rubric.CONDITIONAL: Hard gates pass; soft Bayesian/stability incomplete → shadow/canary only.
evaluator_rubric.HOLD: Any hard gate fails (lift / fairness / granularity / human share).
